prompts.idle: Use case: historical-scene object icon. Use the supplied images for rendering STYLE ONLY; create a NEW single transparent RGBA icon for a medieval Bashu/Sichuan grand-strategy game's idle civic-project button. Highest priority: unmistakable at a final object size of 36 pixels. Depict ONE squat hourglass, bold X-shaped empty center, broad simple upper and lower rails of desaturated SLATE BLUE-GRAY painted wood, a thick pale ivory sand column and simple glass bulbs, almost front-facing. Color identity must be clearly cool gray-blue, NOT brown or beige overall. Finely hand-painted historical inventory-object treatment matching the references, restrained soft highlights and realistic worn materials; large masses and crisp silhouette, very little decorative detail. A few dull silver fasteners only; no gold ornament, no coins, map, book, paper, tabletop or other objects. Single compact centered object on genuinely transparent RGBA, square canvas, fully contained with 12 percent clear padding. No scenery, no circle or medallion, no border, no letters, Chinese characters, numbers, labels, shadows making a floor, cartoon, vector, glossy 3D or photographic product rendering. Readable strong X/hourglass outline with light ivory center against gray-blue rails. Output only this icon.
